description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of satisfactory trades.
explanation: Satisfactory trades are a subset of all recorded credit trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this relationship.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number initiated in the last year.
explanation: Trades initiated during the last year are included among the applicant's total recorded trades; preprocessing explicitly enforces this relationship.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of revolving trades with a balance.
explanation: Revolving trades carrying a balance are a subset of all recorded trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this relationship.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of installment trades with a balance.
explanation: Installment trades carrying a balance are a subset of all recorded trades, and preprocessing explicitly enforces this relationship.

description: Trades delinquent for over 90 days are no more numerous than trades delinquent for over 60 days.
explanation: A trade reaching the over-90-day delinquency threshold necessarily reaches the less severe over-60-day threshold when both delinquency counts are observed.

description: Six-month inquiry count is at least the six-month inquiry count excluding the most recent seven days.
explanation: Removing inquiries from a six-month window cannot increase the count; the latter field is defined as a subset of the former.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the combined number of revolving and installment trades carrying balances.
explanation: Revolving and installment account categories are distinct trade types, so their balance-carrying counts together comprise a subset of all recorded trades.

description: The number of revolving trades with balances is at least the number of high-utilization bankcard or national trades.
explanation: A trade qualifying for high balance-to-limit utilization must have a reported revolving balance, making the high-utilization count a subset of balance-carrying revolving trades.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of high-utilization bankcard or national trades.
explanation: High-utilization qualifying trades are recorded credit trades and therefore form a subset of the total trade count.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of trades ever delinquent for over 60 days.
explanation: Trades reaching the over-60-day delinquency threshold are included among all recorded credit trades.

description: Total recorded trades are at least the number of trades ever delinquent for over 90 days.
explanation: Trades reaching the over-90-day delinquency threshold are included among all recorded credit trades.

description: The average trade age in months is at least months since the last trade.
explanation: The most recently opened trade is the youngest recorded trade, so its age is a lower bound on the average age of the recorded trades.

description: After accounting for balance-carrying installment trades, the remaining total trades are at least the number of high-utilization trades.
explanation: High-utilization qualifying trades are revolving trades, while balance-carrying installment trades are a distinct category; both categories are covered by the total trade count.
